scope: Disposable prototypes only. No production authority, schema, or terminal adapter changes.

nodes.text: Can warm activation reduce carrier latency without weakening Worker identity, resource, or Task boundaries?
Start isolated local Pi RPC and record first Session projection.
Replace the RPC Session with new_session and record reset limits.
Replace the SDK Session and observe closure and module state.
Split a disposable Herdr pane and start an unbound probe Pi carrier.
Run a local probe command and graceful shutdown in the reserved unbound carrier.
Import Pi main in a fresh single-use Node process before activation, then apply env, cwd, and profile once.
Bundle and import the exact Pi Team Bright factory before single-use activation, then inspect its unbound tool surface.
Check extension/resource/cwd/model, Session and process identity, tool isolation, reset leakage, cancellation, shutdown, and retention.
Rank mechanisms and select no production change unless every required invariant holds.

predictions: RPC Session replacement is faster than process startup but leaves launch-selected role, cwd, and resources fixed.
SDK Session replacement is faster than process startup but can retain process-scoped extension state.
Reserved pane activation is fast but cannot become a Worker without a new process and exact startup admission.
A single-use preloaded main can remove import from activation time, but cannot safely reset or reuse a failed lease.
An inline preloaded Pi Team Bright factory still has the leader surface until exact Worker admission occurs.
